interval_take: D10 Saturday was a bank holiday and D2 exploded — ₹62.35 Cr, 64-65% night occupancy, 9.5 lakh+ tickets sold in advance (₹34 Cr nett advance alone before first show). This is the second-best second Saturday for any Indian film, fractionally behind Pushpa 2's ₹63 Cr. D0–D10 BOI canonical: ₹773 Cr. The editorial call: D11 Sunday Boxoffy projects ₹65–70 Cr, which would take D0–D11 to ~₹840 Cr — exactly matching Dhurandhar 1's entire India lifetime, in 11 days. D2 is now the second-highest grossing Bollywood film ever domestically (behind only Dhurandhar 1's ₹840 Cr) and will surpass it by D13–D14 (Mon–Tue). On the Hollywood side, Project Hail Mary confirmed $46.8M Wkd 2 (-42%) — better than Dune: Part Two's second weekend, with 10-day domestic at $156.5M. D2 NA has crossed $23M — beating Baahubali 2's $22M NA lifetime in Week 2.

interval_take: Boxoffy correction issued. After cross-referencing BOI and Pinkvilla against Sacnilk, Sacnilk Hindi figures appear inflated — particularly D1 where Sacnilk reports ₹99.1 Cr vs BOI ₹75 Cr and Pinkvilla ₹73 Cr, a 33% gap. Pinkvilla and BOI align closely throughout. Revised canonical: BOI Hindi D0-D7 ₹532 Cr + other languages ~₹30 Cr = ~₹562 Cr India nett. WW ₹1,006.50 Cr is not disputed — Sacnilk WW uses confirmed distributor data. BLOCKBUSTER verdict and all records unchanged — D2 is still historic at any number.
